description: This file defines the code-behind for the 'EditExam' ASP.NET Web Forms page, handling page load event and button click events that transfer the user to different pages within the OnlineExamSystem application.

classes.name: EditExam
classes.description: Partial class for the EditExam ASP.NET page, handling user interactions and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for the page load event, currently does not perform any actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the home button, navigates to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the profile button, navigates to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the leaderboard button, navigates to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: eTheoryB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for editing theory questions, navigates to the Edit Theory page.

methods.name: eMcqB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for editing MCQ questions, navigates to the Edit MCQ page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for logging out, navigates to the Login Page.
